description: Biology: explain animal or plant cell structures in three stages.
subject: biology
code:
from manim import *
RUN = [3.5, 3.5, 3.5]

class CellStructureScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        cell_type = {{cell_type}}
        title = Text({{title}}, font_size=42).to_edge(UP)
        is_plant = cell_type == "plant"
        if is_plant:
            wall = RoundedRectangle(width=6.4, height=3.9, corner_radius=0.25, color=GREEN)
            membrane = RoundedRectangle(width=5.9, height=3.4, corner_radius=0.4, color=TEAL)
            outline = VGroup(wall, membrane)
            first_label = "细胞壁与细胞膜"
        else:
            outline = Ellipse(width=6.4, height=3.9, color=TEAL)
            first_label = "细胞膜"
        nucleus = Circle(radius=0.62, color=PURPLE, fill_opacity=0.5).shift(LEFT * 0.5)
        if is_plant:
            organelles = VGroup(
                Ellipse(width=1.2, height=0.42, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.7).shift(LEFT * 1.8 + UP * 0.8),
                Ellipse(width=1.2, height=0.42, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.7).shift(RIGHT * 1.8 + DOWN * 0.8),
                Ellipse(width=1.5, height=0.9, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3).shift(RIGHT * 0.8),
            )
            organelle_label = "叶绿体与液泡：各有功能"
        else:
            organelles = VGroup(
                Ellipse(width=0.75, height=0.3, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.7).shift(RIGHT * 1.5 + UP * 0.8),
                Ellipse(width=0.75, height=0.3, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.7).shift(RIGHT * 1.2 + DOWN * 0.8),
                Ellipse(width=0.75, height=0.3, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.7).shift(LEFT * 1.9 + DOWN * 0.7),
            )
            organelle_label = "线粒体等细胞器：承担不同功能"
        label = Text(first_label, font_size=30).to_edge(DOWN)
        slot = RUN[0] if len(RUN) > 0 else 3.5
        duration = min(1.4, slot * 0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(outline), FadeIn(label), run_time=duration)
        self.wait(max(0, slot - duration))
        next_label = Text("细胞核：储存遗传信息", font_size=30).to_edge(DOWN)
        slot = RUN[1] if len(RUN) > 1 else 3.5
        duration = min(1.4, slot * 0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(nucleus), Transform(label, next_label), run_time=duration)
        self.wait(max(0, slot - duration))
        last_label = Text(organelle_label, font_size=30).to_edge(DOWN)
        slot = RUN[2] if len(RUN) > 2 else 3.5
        duration = min(1.4, slot * 0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(organelles), Transform(label, last_label), run_time=duration)
        self.wait(max(0, slot - duration))
